title: Job listing; disclosures.
bodyText:
(a) Job listings shall disclose an hourly rate or salary range that reasonably reflects the actual expected compensation.

(b) This section shall not apply to job listings for:

(1) Positions that are internal transfers or promotions within a current employer;

(2) Public employee positions for which salary, benefits, or other compensation are determined pursuant to collective bargaining; or

(3) Positions with employers having fewer than fifty employees.

     (2)  Public employee positions for which salary, benefits, or other compensation are determined pursuant to collective bargaining; or

     (3)  Positions with employers having fewer than fifty employees. [L 2023, c 203, §2]
